_meta.description: ILM for agent-logs-* (monthly index agent-logs-YYYY-MM; ADR-0090 telemetry catch-all). min_age-based delete from origination date (no rollover write-alias — the prior rollover action here was dead: agent-logs-template never set index.lifecycle.name, so no index was ever ILM-managed and agent-logs-000001, its rollover-alias bootstrap index, sat at 0 docs). Retention: 123d (owner rule 2026-10-03: a monthly index keeps the current month plus 3 full months; the longest 4-month run is 123 days). It was 30d, measured from the index's creation on the 1st, so each month's index was deleted the day the next one started: agent-logs-2026-09 was deleted on 2026-10-01. No warm/forcemerge phase: it was omitted when retention was 30d and is not added by the retention change. Authored in FRE-1036, replacing the dead rollover scaffold.
